rule: A 2006 pick belongs to the club that held it on the symmetric league's activation date (2003-12-03): every real trade link dated before that day and not involving real Miami during the career applies (links before the career apply); links on or after it are real moves the simulated clubs did not make (docs/symmetric_league_design.md). Ownership is by the original club's pick, whatever slot the simulated lottery and records give it. A protected pick whose simulated slot falls inside its 2006 protection stays with the original club. A multi-year obligation outstanding at activation carries into 2006 only when the simulated 2005 draft did not convey it (career/Dwyane_Wade/2004-05/09_Draft/draft_order_2005.json); one the simulated 2005 draft conveyed is spent. Simulated trades are not recorded here: Miami's own picks that simulated Miami traded are read from its pick ledger (runtime/lottery.miami_pick_trades), and the 2006 second-round picks clubs gave on the simulated 2005 draft night from that draft's record (runtime/lottery.draft_night_seconds).
status: derived from Basketball-Reference team transaction pages 1997-98 to 2005-06 (every trade naming a 2006 first- or second-round pick), the Wikipedia 2006 draft footnotes, NBADraft.net's 2005 and 2006 traded-picks lists (protections) and the simulated 2005 draft order (multi-year protections)

forfeited.note: No 2006 pick was forfeited: the 2006 draft had 60 selections in two rounds (Wikipedia/BBR 2006 draft).

expansion.note: Charlotte has no fixed slot in 2006: it enters the lottery as an ordinary non-playoff club, eligible for No. 1, and picks in round 2 by record (nba_2006_lottery_rules.json, charlotte_expansion). The keys are kept with null slots so a reader of the 2004 shape sees that no slot is reserved.

protection.2005: lottery-protected: the Clippers keep the pick if they are a lottery club (picks 1-14)
protection.status: sourced (secondary: NBADraft.net 2006 traded picks, 'a 2006 (unprotected) LA Clippers first-round pick'; the Nets' July 15, 2004 release, read through a search-engine extract, describes it as a 2005 pick protected 1-14, else 2006 unprotected); the terms of the earlier years (a lottery-protected future first from June 2000) are not needed
protection.note: The obligation was outstanding at activation and was not conveyed in the simulated 2005 draft (the Clippers' pick was No. 10, inside the 2005 lottery protection; nba_2005_pick_ownership.json did not list it, which gave the same result), so it is due in 2006 without protection.

notes.LAC_round_1: The Clippers' first belongs to Denver (June 2000 to Orlando, August 2002 to Denver), unprotected in 2006; the simulated 2005 draft kept it with the Clippers inside its 2005 lottery protection.
notes.WAS_round_1: Washington's first belongs to Orlando (August 2001), protected 1-3 in 2006 and unprotected in 2007, because the simulated 2005 draft kept it with Washington at No. 9.
notes.CHI_round_2: Chicago's second belongs to Utah via Houston (Sept 2000, Sept 2003).
notes.PHI_round_2: Philadelphia's second went to Atlanta in June 2002 and came back in July 2003: Philadelphia's at activation.
notes.spent_in_2005: Philadelphia (to Denver), Cleveland (to Phoenix) and Phoenix (to San Antonio) owed multi-year protected firsts at activation; the simulated 2005 draft conveyed all three, so each club holds its own 2006 first.
notes.miami: No real Miami trade involving a 2006 pick falls between the career's start (2003-06-26) and activation. Simulated Miami traded its own 2006 first to the New Orleans/Oklahoma City Hornets on 2006-01-16 (pick ledger; runtime/lottery.miami_pick_trades) and holds its own 2006 second.
notes.simulated_draft_night_seconds: Not recorded here (they are simulated trades): in the simulated 2005 draft six clubs moved up and gave their 2006 second-rounders (Detroit to Portland, Sacramento to Phoenix, Boston to Minnesota, Utah to the Lakers, the Lakers to Detroit, Dallas to Minnesota; career/Dwyane_Wade/2004-05/09_Draft/draft_2005.json `trades`). runtime/lottery.py conveys them from the 2006 draft (SIMULATED_SECONDS_FROM), after this file and before Miami's ledger; each of the six clubs held its own 2006 second at activation (none is listed above with another owner). The 2005 order did not convey the 2005 seconds given on the simulated 2004 draft night and stands as recorded.
